H6547R.name: Hophra
H6547R.desc: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6547R.short: Hophra, also known as Pharaoh Apries, was the king of Egypt during the time of the prophet Jeremiah and the Babylonian invasion of Judah.

H6534.name: Parmashta
H6534.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6534.brief: Son of Haman, killed by the Jews
H6534.short: Parmashta was one of Haman's ten sons killed by the Jews in Susa during the events of Purim.

H6535.name: Parnach
H6535.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6535.brief: Father of Elizaphan, leader from Zebulun
H6535.short: Parnach was the father of Elizaphan, the leader from the tribe of Zebulun who helped divide the land of Canaan.

H6551G.name: Parosh
H6551G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6551G.brief: Family that returned from Babylonian exile
H6551G.short: Parosh was the head of a family that returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile, some of whom married foreign women.

H6551H.name: Parosh
H6551H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6551H.short: Parosh was a leader who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel, bringing a group of his descendants.

H6551J.name: Parosh
H6551J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6551J.brief: A clan leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant
H6551J.short: Parosh, a clan leader who sealed the covenant of Nehemiah.

H6551I.name: Parosh
H6551I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6551I.brief: A man involved in repairing Jerusalem's wall
H6551I.short: Parosh, a man who made repairs near the house of Pedaiah son of Parosh.

H6577.name: Parshandatha
H6577.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6577.brief: Son of Haman killed by the Jews
H6577.short: Parshandatha, one of the ten sons of Haman killed by the Jews.

H6515.name: Paruah
H6515.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H6515.brief: Father of one of Solomon's district governors
H6515.short: Paruah, the father of Jehoshaphat, who was one of Solomon's twelve district governors.

H6583G.name: Pashhur
H6583G.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H6583G.brief: Head of a priestly family that returned from exile
H6583G.short: Pashhur, the ancestor of a priestly family that returned from Babylonian exile.

H6583I.name: Pashhur
H6583I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6583I.brief: Priest who opposed Jeremiah and was renamed Magor-missabib
H6583I.short: Pashhur, a priest who opposed Jeremiah and was renamed Magor-missabib, meaning "terror on every side."

H6583J.name: Pashhur
H6583J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6583J.brief: Priest sent by Zedekiah to inquire of Jeremiah
H6583J.short: Pashhur, a priest King Zedekiah sent to inquire of Jeremiah.

H6583K.name: Pashhur
H6583K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6583K.brief: Son of Gedaliah, an official who opposed Jeremiah
H6583K.short: Pashhur, the son of Gedaliah, one of the officials who opposed Jeremiah.

H6583H.name: Pashhur
H6583H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6583H.short: Pashhur, one of the priests who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's time.

H6570.name: Peresh
H6570.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6570.brief: Son of Machir, grandson of Manasseh
H6570.short: Peresh, a son of Machir and grandson of Manasseh, mentioned in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 7.

H6557.name: Perez
H6557.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6557.brief: Son of Judah, ancestor of David and Jesus
H6557.short: Perez, son of Judah and Tamar, was an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

H6522.name: Perizzites
H6522.brief: Canaanite people group living in the land of Canaan
H6522.short: The Perizzites, a Canaanite people group that inhabited the land of Canaan before the Israelite conquest.

H6514.name: Peruda
H6514.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6514.brief: Ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants
H6514.short: Peruda or Perida, the ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

H6547M.name: Pharaoh
H6547M.desc: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6547M.brief: Pharaoh and father-in-law of Mered, a descendant of Judah
H6547M.short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler whose daughter Bithiah married Mered, a descendant of Judah.

H6547K.name: Pharaoh
H6547K.desc: Pharaoh living at the time of United Monarchy
H6547K.short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler who made an alliance with King Solomon and gave him his daughter in marriage.

H6547L.name: Pharaoh
H6547L.desc: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6547L.short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler whom Judah's King Hezekiah sought as an ally against the Assyrian threat.

H6547I.name: Pharaoh
H6547I.desc: Pharaoh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6547I.brief: Egyptian Pharaoh during Moses' birth and early life
H6547I.short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler who oppressed the Israelites and decreed the killing of Hebrew male infants during the time of Moses' birth.

H6547J.name: Pharaoh
H6547J.desc: Pharaoh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6547J.short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler who refused to release the Israelites from slavery, resulting in the ten plagues and the Exodus.

H6547G.name: Pharaoh
H6547G.desc: Pharaoh living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6547G.short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler who took Abraham's wife Sarah into his palace during their visit to Egypt.

H6547H.name: Pharaoh
H6547H.desc: Pharaoh living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6547H.short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler who elevated Joseph to a position of authority and welcomed his family to Egypt during a severe famine.

H6547N.name: Pharaoh
H6547N.desc: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6547N.short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler mentioned among those who would face God's judgment, as prophesied by Jeremiah.

H6502.name: Piram
H6502.short: Piram, the Amorite king of Jarmuth, who joined a coalition against Joshua and the Israelites.

H6513.name: Purah
H6513.brief: Gideon's servant who accompanied him to the Midianite camp
H6513.short: Purah was Gideon's servant who went with him to spy on the Midianite camp.

H6578.name: Euphrates
H6578.brief: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land
H6578.short: The Euphrates, a major river in the ancient Near East, often served as a boundary marker for the Promised Land and was the site of significant events in biblical history.

H6511.name: Parah
H6511.short: Parah was a city allotted to the tribe of Benjamin, located between Avvim and Ophrah.

H6503.name: Parbar
H6503.brief: A colonnade or structure in the temple complex
H6503.short: Parbar was a colonnade or structure located on the west side of the temple complex in Jerusalem.

H6516.name: Parvaim
H6516.brief: A place from which Solomon obtained gold
H6516.short: Parvaim was a place or region from which Solomon obtained gold for decorating the temple in Jerusalem.

H6559.name: Perazim Mount
H6559.brief: A place where David defeated the Philistines
H6559.short: Mount Perazim was the location where David, with God's help, defeated the Philistines, and it is used by Isaiah as an example of God's judgment.

H6560G.name: Perez-uzza
H6560G.brief: A place named after Uzzah's death
H6560G.short: Perez-uzza was the name given to the place where Uzzah died after touching the Ark of the Covenant during its transport to Jerusalem.

H6539.name: Persia
H6539.brief: An empire that ruled over the exiled Jews
H6539.short: Persia was the empire that conquered Babylon and allowed the exiled Jews to return to Jerusalem and rebuild the temple.

H6554.name: Pharpar
H6554.short: Pharpar was one of the rivers of Damascus, mentioned by Naaman the leper when comparing them to the Jordan River in Israel.

H6552.name: Pirathon
H6552.brief: A town in Ephraim, home of several notable Israelites
H6552.short: Pirathon was a town in the hill country of Ephraim, associated with the judge Abdon and two of David's mighty men, Benaiah and Hiddai.
